name: Hearth Kit
summary: A custom element that shows the Prayer Fire hearth film and plays its fire, bowl and gong sounds after a tap. No dependencies.

attributes.name: media
attributes.what: Base URL of the folder that holds the five media files.

attributes.name: sound
attributes.what: off hides the built-in Sound button. The methods still work.

attributes.name: fit
attributes.what: cover or contain: how the film fills the box.

methods.name: light()
methods.what: Starts the fire bed with a soft fade in. Call it from a tap. Resolves true when sound is playing.

methods.name: quiet()
methods.what: Fades the sound out and stops it.

methods.name: ring(name)
methods.what: Strikes 'bowl' or 'gong'. Call it from a tap. Resolves true when it sounded.

methods.name: lit
methods.what: A getter: true while the fire bed is on.

media.what: The film, 12 seconds, looped, no sound track.
The still picture, the first frame of the film.

sound: Never starts by itself. Only the built-in Sound button or a host page's own tap handler starts it. If a sound file cannot be loaded or decoded, a sound generated in the browser plays instead.
motion: With prefers-reduced-motion the film is never loaded; the still picture shows.
crossOrigin: pointcast.xyz does not send a cross-origin header for these files yet. On another site, copy hearth-fire.js and the media files to that site and set media to their folder.
credit: Hearth Kit, Baby Bonfire, PointCast (https://pointcast.xyz/baby-bonfire/hearth-kit/), CC BY 4.0
made: The film and the sounds were generated with AI tools for Prayer Fire on 2026-11-11. The element and this page were written by Claude on 2026-11-13.
tested: Headless Chrome on 2026-11-13 at phone and desktop sizes. Not yet run on a phone or heard by a person.
